posts.title: If You Can't Own the PR, Please Don't Open One
posts.description: A pull request should be opened by the person who can explain the change, assess its risk, and handle the fallout if it goes wrong.

posts.title: Generation Is Cheap. Judgment Isn't.
posts.description: Code generation keeps getting cheaper. But someone still has to read it. Turns out the highest-leverage skill in 2026 might not be writing code - it's deciding whether it should ship.

posts.title: Automating Myself Out of My Job - Part 2
posts.description: I'm guilty of every bad commit message sin in the book. So I built a Claude Code skill that writes them better than I ever did.
